nextAllowedMove: Run exactly one worker Vitest campaign with four invocations; then one synthetic visual only if all campaign invocations pass.

campaign.failurePolicy: Any unexpected invocation failure stops the campaign; no automatic retry and no visual run after failure.
campaign.rawBackupPolicy: Preserve the unique OS-temporary full-tree backup path emitted by the committed runner and record its actual path; do not delete or retry.

visual.invocations: Exactly one, only if all four worker Vitest invocations pass
visual.outputs: Record actual temp screenshot/report/log paths; if all checks pass, copy four PNGs and raw report/logs into new worker proof paths and record hashes; no rerun.
visual.matrix: English/Vietnamese x desktop/mobile, isolated synthetic fixture with blocked external requests and native keyboard checks

priorMetadataFailure.error: PowerShell hashtable used bare true instead of $true; command failed before campaign or any runtime invocation; initial plan file contained JSON null.
priorMetadataFailure.disclosure: No runtime was run during the failed plan-authoring attempt.
